This mod replace [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29979?tab=description]Bountiful Beauties Vol. 1[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37227]Vol. 2[/url], make it more Simply.

My English is terrible, so I use a translator to complete this description.
Thanks again [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TheMud?gameId=1303]Mud[/url] to create those mods.  
If the original author requests the removal of this mod, I will delete it.

(After I finished this description. I accident delete the entire description.so I have to do it again, sad.)
